$comment: Draft question text for REV57. No default probability threshold, owner labels, measured quality, or sending authority. Freeze only after owner-marked development measurements; keep question and decision digests distinct.

consent_pressure.instructions: Does `draft.text` pressure a prospect to grant consent or continue contact despite the explicit permission state and latest stop request in `contact_policy`? Do not infer consent from a purchase discussion, meeting request, positive sentiment, or a model judgment.

criteria.true: The draft negotiates around a stop request, implies contact permission without explicit applicable consent, or pressures the prospect to authorize further contact.
criteria.false: The draft preserves unknown permission, respects the applicable stop request, and does not pressure the prospect to authorize contact.
